jobs.title: Business Development Manager
jobs.description: We are seeking an energetic, results-driven Business Development Manager to lead our sales expansion and shop partner network across the Philippines. In this role, you will be the face of our brand in the field—building strong relationships with independent auto shops, modification centers, and parts distributors, while driving B2B sales for our proprietary line of high-performance car parts. Working directly alongside our CEO, you will have a direct impact on our nationwide growth, brand presence, and commercial strategy. What You'll Do Identify, target, and sign high-potential auto repair, detailing, and modification shops across key regions in the Philippines to become authorized partners or stockists. Negotiate partnership terms, wholesale pricing agreements, and shop endorsement packages that drive mutual growth. Serve as the primary relationship manager for all partner shops, ensuring long-term brand loyalty and repeat orders. Conduct regular on-site shop visits, product demonstrations, and technical briefings to educate shop owners and mechanics on our branded parts catalog. Pitch and close B2B sales orders for inventory stocking, build projects, and exclusive product lines. Identify regional market trends, competitor pricing, and emerging product demand to refine sales pitches on the ground. Collaborate directly with the CEO to align field initiatives with overall company revenue and expansion goals. Maintain accurate records of field visits, sales pipelines, partner feedback, and accounts through regular CRM updates and sales reports. Coordinate with internal logistics and inventory teams to ensure seamless product delivery and fulfillment for partner shops.

jobs.title: Auto Mechanic
jobs.description: At I&I Automotive Modifications , we don't just fix cars—we elevate them. Specializing in high-end luxury maintenance, performance upgrades, and custom modification builds, our shop operates at the highest standards of automotive excellence. We are looking for a skilled, detail-oriented Auto Mechanic who takes pride in precision work and loves working on high-performance machinery. What You'll Do Perform thorough inspections and computer-aided diagnostics to accurately identify engine, drivetrain, electronic, and mechanical issues on luxury and performance vehicles. Precision-repair or replace worn, damaged, or upgraded parts to ensure optimal performance, structural integrity, and reliability. Execute high-standard routine maintenance, including synthetic oil, filter, fluid changes, and multi-point safety checks in accordance with OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) specifications. Adjust, align, and calibrate mechanical, suspension, and electronic components—including Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS) and sensors—to strict manufacturer tolerances. Perform comprehensive safety checks and emissions inspections as required. Maintain accurate records of all diagnostic steps, services rendered, and parts utilized to support precise invoicing and customer vehicle history. Collaborate with Project Manager to communicate diagnostic findings, explain complex technical issues, and identify necessary or preventative repair recommendations. Follow detailed work orders, project plans, and technical instructions from leadership; collaborate closely with Project Manager to ensure timeline adherence, regular status updates, and smooth project execution. Work cooperatively with fellow technicians, and Project Manager to communicate diagnostic findings, explain complex technical issues, and address additional repair needs.

jobs.title: HR Business Partner
jobs.description: Role Overview We are hiring an HR Business Partner to build and run Moongig’s people function as the team grows. You will be the founders’ partner on org design, hiring, performance, compensation, and culture, and you will own the HR operations and labor compliance that keep a Philippine company in good standing. In year one this role is hands-on: you design the system and you run it. As the team grows, routine operations move to an HR associate or an outsourced provider, and your time shifts toward partnering with leaders. Key Responsibilities Org Design & Workforce Planning: Turn company plans (funding milestones, new markets, product roadmap) into a headcount plan, budget, and hiring sequence Define roles, levels, and reporting lines as teams form across engineering, operations, and business development Advise the founders on whether to hire, contract, or outsource each function Talent Acquisition: Own hiring end to end: role scoping with the hiring manager, sourcing, structured interviews, offers, and closing Set the hiring standard: scorecards, defined interview loops, and a consistent bar across teams Performance, Compensation & Growth: Design and run the performance cycle: goal setting, mid-year and annual reviews, and regularization decisions at the end of probation Build the compensation framework: salary bands, benchmarking against Manila market data, and an annual review process Coach managers, many of them first-time managers, on feedback, underperformance, and development conversations Spot retention risks among key people and bring the founders a plan before they turn into resignations Employee Relations & Labor Compliance: Handle employee relations cases end to end: investigation, due process under the twin-notice rule, documentation, and resolution, with legal counsel where needed Keep Moongig compliant with the Labor Code, DOLE rules, the Data Privacy Act (RA 10173), and the OSH Law (RA 11058), including all mandatory workplace policies Represent th

jobs.title: Lead Engineer Salesforce AI Agentforce
jobs.description: Define, document, and enforce Emerson AI governance policies, ethical guidelines, compliance expectations, and approval standards for Salesforce AI capabilities, including Agentforce and Einstein. Review proposed AI toolsets and agent use cases across business functions for regulatory, ethical, privacy, security, and business-process readiness. Establish practical guardrails for agent design, topic configuration, actions, data grounding, escalation, auditability, and human oversight. Track evolving AI regulations, Salesforce trust guidance, and corporate policies, translating requirements into usable governance practices for delivery teams. Create AI risk assessment templates, model/use-case review checkpoints, exception processes, and remediation procedures for Salesforce AI deployments. Advise workstream teams on Agentforce design patterns, agent topics, actions, instructions, prompt quality, hallucination prevention, and safe handoff to human users. Enable responsible AI innovation by helping teams move from concept to governed pilots, production readiness, and measurable business outcomes. Partner with Data Cloud, Data Stewardship, and Integration teams to ensure agent grounding data is accurate, permission-aware, compliant, and fit for intended use. Develop reusable Agentforce patterns, documentation, training materials, and playbooks to accelerate consistent adoption across Business Groups and World Areas. Audit AI agent usage, performance, quality, compliance, bias risk, and outcome measures, coordinating remediation actions when issues are identified. Define AI trust and safety metrics, adoption metrics, value measures, and executive reporting for Salesforce AI capabilities. Partner with Security, Legal, Compliance, Architecture, and Data teams to ensure AI controls align with Emerson enterprise policies and risk posture. Support post-deployment reviews, incident learnings, and continuous improvement of AI governance standards and agent operating models.
